title.narrative: Program to Strengthen Public Policy and Fiscal Management in Response to the Health and Economic Crises caused by COVID-19 in El Salvador
Programa de Fortalecimiento de la Poltica Pblica y Gestin Fiscal para la Atencin de la Crisis Sanitaria y Econmica causada por el COVID-19 en El Salvador

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es fortalecer la eficiencia y eficacia de la poltica pblica y la gestin fiscal para atender la crisis sanitaria y econmica causada por el COVID-19, mediante el diseo e implementacin de medidas de poltica efectivas y fiscalmente responsables.

The objective of the program is to strengthen the efficiency and efficacy of public policy and fiscal management to address the health and economic crises caused by the COVID-19 pandemic, through the design and implementation of effective and fiscally responsible policy measures.
Commitment in 2020-06-08
Disbursement in third quarter of 2020
